body.message:
As per your request, please find below the 3-month rates for a 2-bedroom apartment at Miraclz Tower, Arjan, Dubai:

September: AED 10,500
October: AED 11,500
November: AED 13,000

Refundable Security Deposit: AED 3,000

Please note that the booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

To confirm and secure the 3-month booking, the first month's rent, last month's rent, and refundable security deposit must be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the unit and guarantee the agreed rates for the confirmed booking period.

Please let us know if you would like to proceed, and we will be happy to assist you with the next steps.

Thank you.
